pravni.seoDescription: Generate certified statements and legal documents compliant with the legislation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH, RS, Brčko District).
pravni.jurisdiction: Bosnia and Herzegovina · FBiH · RS · Brčko District
pravni.subtitle: Quickly and privately generate statements given under material and criminal liability, tailored to the legal system of Bosnia and Herzegovina. All content is processed in your browser.
pravni.badgePrivate: Private — nothing sent to a server
pravni.noteText: The generated documents are templates aligned with the legal system of Bosnia and Herzegovina (the FBiH and Republika Srpska entities and Brčko District). For legal validity, certification before a competent authority is required: a notary, a municipal officer or the competent court. BH KONVER does not provide legal advice and is not a substitute for a lawyer.
